field.label: Active (Use this Server)
field.help: Enable this outbound server node.

field.label: Node Name / Remarks
field.help: Friendly name for this server (automatically extracted from #remark when importing vless:// links).

field.label: UUID / Password
field.help: User UUID (VLESS/VMess) or Password (Trojan/Shadowsocks).

field.label: Username
field.help: Username for SOCKS, HTTP or MASQUE authentication. Leave empty when the server does not require auth.

field.label: Password
field.help: Password for SOCKS, HTTP or MASQUE authentication.

field.label: XTLS Flow
field.help: Flow control algorithm for VLESS (usually xtls-rprx-vision for REALITY/TLS).

field.label: Encryption
field.help: Keep as "none" for standard VLESS, or paste a VLESS Encryption string generated by "xray vlessenc".

field.label: VMess Experiments
field.help: Optional experimental flags separated by "|", e.g. AuthenticatedLength|NoTerminationSignal.

field.label: Client Private Key
field.help: Client private key (PrivateKey generated by "xray wg").

field.label: Peer Public Key
field.help: Server public key (Password/PublicKey generated by "xray wg").

field.label: Peer Endpoint (host:port)
field.help: Server address and port, e.g. example.com:51820.

field.label: Local Address(es)
field.help: Local IP addresses assigned inside the WireGuard tunnel (e.g. 10.0.0.1).

field.label: Allowed IPs
field.help: Destinations routed through the peer, usually 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0.

field.label: Persistent Keepalive (seconds)
field.help: 0 disables keepalive packets.

field.label: Inner MTU
field.help: Default 1420 (IPv6 endpoint) or 1440 (IPv4 endpoint).

field.label: Reserved Bytes
field.help: Three comma-separated bytes, e.g. 0,0,0.

field.label: Remote DNS Servers
field.help: DNS servers used inside the tunnel to resolve proxied domain names (IP addresses only).

field.label: Redirect To (host:port)
field.help: Rewrite the destination, e.g. 127.0.0.1:3366. Use :443 to keep the address, host:0 to keep the port.

field.label: PROXY Protocol
field.help: Used together with Redirect when the backend supports the PROXY protocol.

field.label: Final Rules (JSON array)
field.help: Optional JSON array, e.g. [{"action":"block","network":"tcp","port":"25,465"}]. Leave empty to use the built-in safety policy.

field.label: Response
field.help: Close the connection immediately, or send a simple HTTP 403 response before closing.

field.label: Rewrite DNS Server Address
field.help: Leave empty to keep the address requested by the source.

field.label: Rewrite DNS Server Port
field.help: Leave empty to keep the port requested by the source.

field.label: DNS Rules (JSON array)
field.help: Optional JSON array, e.g. [{"action":"return","rCode":3,"domain":["domain:ads.example"]}].

field.label: Inbound Tag
field.help: Tag used when traffic re-enters routing. Avoid rules that send it back to this outbound.

field.label: Hysteria Auth Password
field.help: Must match the server. Hysteria always uses TLS transport.

field.label: UDP Idle Timeout (seconds)
field.help: Idle timeout for a single QUIC native UDP connection (default 60).

field.label: MASQUE Authority (:authority)
field.help: Optional CONNECT-IP :authority. Priority: host > SNI > server address.

field.label: MASQUE Path Template
field.help: RFC 9484 path, default /.well-known/masque/ip/{target}/{ipproto}/.

field.label: Remote DNS Servers
field.help: DNS servers used inside the MASQUE tunnel (IP addresses only).

field.label: Transport Network (type)
field.help: Transport method. Not used by WireGuard, Freedom, Blackhole, DNS and Loopback; Hysteria and MASQUE always use their native transport.

field.label: Stream Security
field.help: Hysteria and MASQUE always require TLS.

field.label: Server Name (SNI)
field.help: SNI hostname used during TLS/REALITY handshake.

field.label: ALPN
field.help: Optional ALPN values (e.g., h2, http/1.1). For MASQUE, h2 selects HTTP/2; otherwise HTTP/3 is used.

field.label: Extra HTTP Headers (JSON map)
field.help: Optional JSON object with extra headers, e.g. {"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}. Used by HTTP outbound and MASQUE.

field.label: Custom StreamSettings Override (Optional JSON)
field.help: Optional JSON object merged into streamSettings (e.g. {"wsSettings":{"path":"/"}}). Outer braces are stripped; leave empty to use the UI fields above. Must be valid JSON.
